questions.q_en: A worker earned Rs. 20/- on one day and spent Rs. 15/- on the next day. He again earned Rs. 20/- on the third day and spent Rs. 15/- on the fourth day and so on. On which day he will first have the 60 with him?
questions.solution_en:
On every odd day he is earning Rs. 20/-

On every even day he is spending Rs. 15/-

For every 2 days, he is saving Rs. 5/-

So till 16th day, he has saved = 5 * 8 = Rs. 40/-

On 17th day, he earns Rs. 20 i.e. 40 + 20 = Rs. 60/-

Thus the total number of days required = 17 days

Hence the correct answer is option A.

From 3: √(B * C * D) = √(24 * 36 * 12) = 72√2

A person has total 500 chocolates. He gives 4 chocolates to 'm' boys each and 5 chocolates to 'n' girls each. Which of the following statement is true?

I. m = 75, n = 40

II. m = 60, n = 52
questions.solution_en:
Total number of chocolates = 4m + 5n = 400

From I:

m = 75, n = 40

Then, 4 * 75 + 5 * 40 = 300 + 200 = 500

So, this statement is true.

From II:

m = 60, n = 52

Then, 4 * 60 + 5 * 52 = 240 + 260 = 500

So, this statement is true.

questions.q_en: In a class, 430 chocolates were distributed among 90 students in such a way that each boy got 6 chocolates, and each girl got 4 chocolates. Find the total number of girls in the class.
questions.solution_en:
Let the total number of girls be 'X'

Boys = 90 - X

According to question,

X * 4 + (90 - X) * 6 = 430

4X + 540 - 6X = 430

2X = 110

X = 55

questions.q_en:
If an even number is added to the average of five consecutive odd numbers, we get Z and if an odd number is added to the average of five consecutive odd numbers, we get A. Which of the following will be the possible value of product of Z and A?

1) 25

2) 42

3) 45
questions.solution_en:
Average of five consecutive odd number will also be an odd number.

We know that,

Odd + odd = Even so, A will be an even number

Odd + even = Odd so, Z will be an odd number

Now,

We know that product of an even number and odd number is always an even number.

So, Z * A = even number.

Therefore, Possible value of Z * A will be 42.

questions.q_en: There are total 568 students in a school. If number of girls in school are two-third more than the number of boys in the school. How many girls are there in the school?
questions.solution_en:
Total number of students = 568

Let number of boys = n

Then, number of girls = (1 + 2/3) * n = 5n/3

Now, 568 = n + 5n/3

n = 213

Therefore, number of girls = 568 - 213 = 355

First eight odd natural number = 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15

Sum of first eight odd natural numbers = 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 9 + 11 + 13 + 15 = 64

Required ratio = 58: 64 = 29: 32

questions.q_en:
Which of the following statement is true?

I. 64 X 55 is even

II. 45 X 75 is even
questions.solution_en:
I. 64 X 55

When an even number is multiplied by another even number then their solution will be even. So, 64 will be even.

Similarly, when an odd number is multiplied by another odd number then their solution will be odd. So, 55 will be odd.

Multiplication of an even and an odd number always given an even value.

So, 64 X 55is even.

Hence, statement I is true.

II. 45 X 75

When an even number is multiplied by another even number then their solution will be even. So, 45 will be even.

Similarly, when an odd number is multiplied by another odd number then their solution will be odd. So, 75 will be odd.

Multiplication of an even and an odd number always given an even value.

So, 45 X 75 is even.

Hence, statement II is true.

questions.solution_en:
option 1:

xy + 1 = Even * Even + odd = Even + odd = odd

Hence, option 1 is odd

option 2:

x+y+xy = Even + Even + Even * Even = Even

Hence, option 2 is even

Option 3:

x + y + 2 = even + even + even = even

Hence, option 2 is even

Option 4:

3x + y = odd * even + even = even + even = even

Hence, option 4 is even
